task: Add an exported function `chunk<T>(items: readonly T[], size: number): T[][]` to src/utils/array.ts. It splits the array into consecutive groups of `size` elements in their original order, with the last group holding whatever is left, so that `chunk([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 2)` is `[[1, 2], [3, 4], [5]]` and `chunk([], 3)` is `[]`. It throws a RangeError whose message names the size it was given when `size` is not a positive integer, so 0, -1, 1.5, NaN and Infinity all throw. It must not mutate its input. Add unit tests for it at tests/unit/utils/array.tests.ts, run by `npm run test:unit`. Keep every existing test passing.
